skill.description: Plan LLM projects by validating task fit, designing staged pipelines, estimating costs, choosing agent architecture, and defining structured output contracts.

skill.author: muratcankoylan

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives caused by Markdown formatting, documentation examples, benign citations, and mislabeled text. The executable template has medium-risk path traversal, HTML injection, and indirect prompt injection weaknesses. These issues should be fixed before marketplace publication.

remediation.issue: Batch and item identifiers can escape configured data and output directories.
remediation.suggestion: Reject absolute paths and separators, allow only a strict identifier pattern, and verify every resolved path remains under its configured root.

remediation.issue: The generated HTML interpolates batch_id without escaping.
remediation.suggestion: Escape batch_id with html.escape before every HTML insertion, and add a test containing markup characters.

remediation.issue: Acquired content shares the instruction channel with pipeline directions.
remediation.suggestion: Mark source text as untrusted data, isolate it with provider-supported message boundaries, validate outputs, and test adversarial source content.

semantic_findings.title: Unvalidated Identifiers Permit Path Traversal
semantic_findings.description: Batch and item identifiers are joined without validation. Absolute or traversal paths can redirect writes and cleanup deletions outside intended directories.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The CLI value reaches Path joins without confinement checks, and cleanup unlinks files beneath the resulting path.

semantic_findings.title: Generated HTML Includes Unescaped Batch Identifier
semantic_findings.description: The batch identifier is inserted into title and heading markup without escaping. A crafted identifier can inject active content when the report opens.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The CLI-controlled batch_id is interpolated directly into two HTML contexts while other displayed strings are explicitly escaped.

content.value_statement: LLM projects often fail because task fit, architecture, costs, and output contracts remain unclear. This skill provides a staged method and reusable pipeline template.
actual_capabilities: Evaluates whether an LLM matches a task using explicit proceed and stop criteria.
Structures projects into acquire, prepare, process, parse, and render stages.
Estimates token usage and processing costs with a retry buffer.
Guides project-level choices between single-agent and multi-agent architectures.
Defines structured output contracts and tolerant parsing practices.
Provides a Python batch pipeline template with caching, cleanup, rendering, and cost estimation.
limitations: The included LLM call is a mock and requires provider integration.
The template does not provide deployment, authentication, monitoring, or production infrastructure.
Path identifiers and generated HTML require security hardening before production use.
Cost estimates use configurable assumptions and do not query current provider pricing.

use_cases.title: Plan a Batch Analysis Product
use_cases.description: Define stages, intermediate artifacts, parsing contracts, and cost estimates before implementation.
use_cases.target_user: Product engineers planning an LLM batch workflow

use_cases.title: Review an Agent Architecture
use_cases.description: Compare single-agent and multi-agent options against complexity, context, quality, and cost requirements.
use_cases.target_user: Technical leads reviewing an AI system design

use_cases.title: Prototype a Research Pipeline
use_cases.description: Adapt the staged Python template for source acquisition, model processing, result parsing, and report rendering.

prompt_templates.title: Check Task Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess whether an LLM suits this task: [task]. List proceed signals, stop signals, one manual test, and a clear recommendation.

prompt_templates.title: Design Pipeline Stages
prompt_templates.prompt: Design acquire, prepare, process, parse, and render stages for [project]. Define each input, output, cache boundary, failure mode, and rerun behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Estimate Cost and Scale
prompt_templates.prompt: Estimate costs for [item count], [input tokens], [output tokens], and [model prices]. Include retries, concurrency assumptions, uncertainty, and reduction options.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Complete Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this LLM project architecture: [design]. Challenge task fit, agent topology, trust boundaries, structured outputs, evaluation gates, costs, recovery, and operational risks.

output_examples.input: Design a pipeline that summarizes 5,000 support tickets into weekly themes.
output: Recommendation: use a single-agent batch pipeline because tickets are independent.
Stages: acquire tickets, normalize text, summarize each ticket, aggregate themes, and render the weekly report.
Validation: manually test representative tickets and measure theme accuracy before scaling.
Cost plan: estimate input and output tokens, then add a retry buffer.

output_examples.input: Should a compliance document checker use multiple agents?
output: Start with one agent and deterministic validation rules.
Add specialized agents only when benchmark results show measurable gains.
Require human review because compliance decisions have low error tolerance.

output_examples.input: Create a parsing contract for model-generated product evaluations.
output_examples.output: Use fixed section headers, enumerated ratings, explicit missing-value rules, tolerant extraction, and logged validation failures for human review.

best_practices: Run one representative manual test before automating the workflow.
Persist stage outputs so expensive model calls remain cacheable and independently rerunnable.
Measure quality and actual token costs throughout development.
anti_patterns: Do not choose multiple agents without evidence that simpler designs fail.
Do not combine acquisition, model calls, parsing, and rendering into one opaque step.
Do not assume model output always follows the requested format.

faq.question: Does this skill call an LLM provider?
faq.answer: No. The Python template returns a mock response until you implement a provider client.

faq.question: Can it design multi-agent systems?
faq.answer: It supports the project-level choice between single and multiple agents. Detailed topology design belongs to a specialized multi-agent skill.

faq.question: Does it calculate exact production costs?
faq.answer: No. It provides an estimation method using item counts, token assumptions, pricing inputs, and a retry buffer.

faq.question: What outputs does the template create?
faq.answer: It creates staged local artifacts, aggregated results, and a static HTML report.

faq.question: Is the template production ready?
faq.answer: No. Add provider integration, security validation, tests, monitoring, authentication, and deployment controls before production use.

faq.question: Which tools support this skill?
faq.answer: The skill supports Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
